video_title: Jaylen Brown reacts to the New York Knicks winning NBA Finals

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown credits the Knicks for their championship run
quotes.excerpt: JB is a dog and them dudes work hard in that organization for them to get there.
quotes.quote: Congrats to the Knicks. Shout out to Jalen Brunson and all of those guys, OG, Bridges. Incredible run and you got to give credit obviously. It is painful to see, painful to see, but you got to tip your cap. Jalen Brunson is a dog and them dudes work hard in that organization for them to get there. I know how important that was. It has been I don't know how long, so I know New York is excited about that.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown discusses parity in the NBA over seven years
quotes.excerpt: The last seven years has been seven different champions, which is interesting.
quotes.quote: The last seven years has been seven different champions, which is interesting. I think the apron and stuff like that definitely has something to do with how the ball has been bouncing in terms of each year. I'm looking forward to the next season, it's any man's game.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on his personal growth and development
quotes.excerpt: I feel confident in the sense where I'm coming into my physicality, my mental game.
quotes.quote: I feel confident in the sense where I'm coming into my physicality, my mental game, my weaknesses are turning into my strengths. You have not seen the best version of Jaylen Brown. I look forward to the next season, we'll see where the chips fall.
